<!-- pr-reviewer: 3458a7ac18c5fcde28a65439695306daf53cb22c -->
**Verdict: Not built - needs a maintainer look.**

Thanks for the PR, @mkinney. Review rules say a PR that adds a dependency is read but not built or run by the reviewer, so nothing below was compiled locally.

**Needs a maintainer look first**
- `Cargo.toml` (workspace) adds `png = "0.18"`, `crates/app/Cargo.toml` adds `png = { workspace = true }`, and `Cargo.lock` gains one line (`png` under camcraft-app). `png 0.18.1` is already in the lock file as a transitive dependency of `image`, so no new crate enters the tree. It is still a new direct dependency, and the maintainer should confirm that.

**Merge with main**
- A trial merge (`git merge-tree`) of the head with current `origin/main` is clean, including `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs` and `tools.rs` after #444. No conflicts.

**What looks good (read of the diff)**
- `crates/app/src/raster.rs` skips degenerate input instead of panicking: non-finite vertices, zero-area projections, and out-of-canvas pixels (all indexing goes through `get`/`get_mut`). Sizes are validated at the tool boundary (`render.rs` `edge`, 16..2048), and the overlay line walk is capped.
- `render_stock` refuses with named reasons: no simulation, an empty surface, no finite extent. It reuses the post gate's own sim, so the picture matches what the gate judges. Unknown deviation classes paint as "unjudged", never "clean" (`render.rs` `paint`).
- The PNG is lifted out of the JSON into an image content block, so the base64 is not duplicated in `structuredContent`.
- Provenance lines are present, the decision record is `docs/decisions/182-mcp-sim-render.md`, and the body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #182`. The new files are around 250 lines each, under the 400-line guide.
- The pinning tests in `crates/app/tests/mcp_render.rs` cover a real cut and a through-cut.

**Not verified here**
- No build, no `mcp_render` or `mcp` suite run, no clippy. Clippy and the suites should run after the maintainer clears the dependency.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `render.rs`: there are no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests. The `as i64` casts in `scene` (`key`) and in `raster.rs` act on finite, rounded values, so they are fine.
- The handshake `instructions` text in `mcp/mod.rs` does not mention `render_stock` (noted in the PR comment). It would be worth a follow-up so clients discover the tool.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
